title: PaveCarbon: coupled finite-element and life-cycle framework for nano-silica warm mix asphalt pavements
description: Open Python code accompanying the manuscript 'From laboratory durability to annualised carbon: an open finite-element and life-cycle framework for nano-silica-modified warm mix asphalt pavements' (Discover Civil Engineering, under review). Axisymmetric Q9 finite-element solver verified against Boussinesq, Witczak moduli for monthly temperature states, MEPDG fatigue and rutting with Miner's rule, annualised A1-A3 carbon, one-at-a-time and Monte Carlo sensitivity.
